interpretation: Tests selected qualitative hypotheses in a constructed local testbed; not reproduction of numerical paper results.
unimplemented_provider_topics: Cloud placement, adversarial co-location, CPU/cache/covert channels
Real provider IAM convergence and billing
Vulnerability intelligence for dependencies and production attack prevalence

events.hypothesis: Validate internal and external event schemas; verify integrity before use.
limits: Constructed event corpus, not an injection vulnerability scanner.
Acceptance measures schema/integrity violations; payload strings are never executed.
HMAC is a local integrity mechanism, not a public-key signature or replay defense.

authorization.hypothesis: Gateway authentication alone leaves internal entry points exposed; enforce exact capabilities.
limits: Python reference monitor, not OS isolation, IAM, tenant identity or cloud enforcement.

dependencies.hypothesis: Track third-party artifacts; reject changed or unlisted components before use.
limits: Hash pinning detects changes, not known vulnerabilities or malicious trusted artifacts.
Trusted inventory storage is assumed; no exploit code is imported.

persistence.hypothesis: Reuse retains attacker state; a fresh workspace or declared-content monitoring removes it.
limits: The implant is an inert marker, not arbitrary malware or a container escape.
A fixed cache allowlist operationalizes the paper's legitimate/malicious distinction.
No host isolation guarantee; timing covers process startup, calls, cleanup and shutdown.
All modes run one compromise and two legitimate calls; fresh mode starts a second process.

side-channels.kind: measured local workflows with controlled service delays
side-channels.hypothesis: Branch-specific traces/timing reveal roles; a facade restricts trace visibility and padding reduces timing signal.
side-channels.observer: External observer sees exported trace names and total response time, not internal traces.
limits: Service delays (user 1 ms, admin 3 ms) are constructed; wall-clock times are measured.
Training and test calls are disjoint, balanced and randomized; no attacker uses test labels to fit.
Wilson intervals describe sample proportions, not proof of independence or zero leakage.
The facade deliberately hides internal names from this observer; privileged telemetry observers still see them.
Simple sleep padding can itself retain role-dependent timing on some hosts.
Deadline padding spins for up to the final 2 ms, increasing CPU cost; no constant-time guarantee.
Padding may leak under contention or slow handlers; accuracy need not equal chance.

rollouts.kind: concurrent requests to a local in-process replica pool
rollouts.hypothesis: Partial updates leave revoked access reachable; atomic code/policy cutover prevents post-cutover stale access.
limits: Four replica objects share one host and synchronization lock, not distributed nodes.
The stale-version window is intentionally forced; its production frequency is not estimated.
In-flight requests admitted before revocation may finish; protected cutover waits for them.
No packet loss, provider convergence or cloud availability claim.

billing.kind: synthetic labeled demand; actual local function dispatch ledger
billing.hypothesis: Anomaly detection and quotas can limit wallet abuse, with missed attacks and legitimate drops.

configuration.price_units: arbitrary cost units per accepted invocation

limits: Simulated minutes advance immediately, not a wall-clock load or scalability benchmark.
No cloud bill, real concurrency quota, network overhead, retries or downstream costs.
Labels are hidden from enforcement; legitimate bursts can page and lose legitimate requests.
Bucket labels and repeated fixture trials are correlated; do not treat them as a real-world attack population.
Demand for all control variants is paired exactly; alert-only never rejects an invocation.

framework.kind: integrated local text-document workflow and component ablations
framework.hypothesis: Independent audit, approval, policy and telemetry controls change admission and failure behavior.
limits: SQLite and trusted Python objects model service boundaries; they are not IAM or process isolation.
Audit ACK is a FULL synchronous SQLite commit; it is not provider retention or proof against the filesystem owner.
Replaced-target success measures acceptance of a mismatched grant, not deletion of the replacement in every ablation.
Fault outcomes report side effects separately; exit audit failure cannot undo committed work.
Initialization, local storage setup and scenario work are included in total trial timing.

sensitivity.kind: paired 3-by-3 detector threshold and invocation quota sweep
sensitivity.hypothesis: Detector sensitivity and admission budgets trade missed attacks against legitimate rejection.
limits: Prespecified settings are reported together; no best configuration is selected on these workloads.
Independent workload seeds vary traffic within the same five constructed workload families.
Synthetic buckets and modeled costs do not measure cloud scalability or bills.

lifecycle.kind: two isolated Python interpreters per trial sharing durable local state
lifecycle.hypothesis: Key continuity and audited policy history preserve revocation and permit independently authorized recovery after a grant expires.
limits: Normal interpreter exit/restart, not host power loss, filesystem corruption or distributed failover.
The fixed clock advances from 1000 to 1040 seconds without waiting; this tests expiry semantics.
Keys remain in an owner-readable mode-0600 file; no external key manager or key rotation is claimed.
Invocation budgets are process-local and reset on restart; their restart continuity is not evaluated.
A complete local owner can replace state and keys; independently retained anchors remain necessary.

robustness.kind: paired nonstationary and intermittent demand with a fixed-training comparator
robustness.hypothesis: A frozen training reference and adapting EWMA differ under legitimate drift and intermittent abuse.
limits: Six new synthetic workload families, not production traces or an unseen real-world attack sample.
Added after the initial study; these are disclosed follow-up probes, not a preregistered validation set.
Training-reference parameters are fixed and all comparator outcomes retained; no best setting selected.
Detection labels remain hidden; legitimate growth can be flagged and confirmation can miss pulses.
Only local dispatch and arbitrary cost units; no cloud billing or distributed enforcement.
